This application is created for listening to Internet radio stations.
Therefor we use database https://www.radio-browser.info/ that contains information about Internet radio stations all over the world.
Just click on the place on the map you are insterested in, chose radiostation from the list and enjoy!

The app also uses images from pixabay.com and country coordinates from https://developers.google.com/public-data/ (sep. 2023). Country names are taken from external sources and may not correspond to modern realities.
